title: Canva Seizes World's No. 2 Image Lab Rank With Craft AI
summary:
The latest image generation tool from Canva entered the DesignArena leaderboard in fourth place with an Elo score of 1340. Named Craft, the model outperformed rivals including Google's Nano Banana 2.1, Microsoft's MAI-Image-2.6, Meta's Muse Image 1.0, and ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Pro, with only OpenAI models ranking higher. This debut elevates Canva to the position of the world's second-most advanced AI image lab globally.

Craft was trained on human-designed templates such as infographics and posters rather than photographs to prioritize precise layout and placement. The model utilizes a two-stage process where a planner maps the composition before a renderer generates the final image at up to 2K resolution in 55 languages. It currently ranks first in DesignArena's portrait and landscape subcategories and is available via Dream Lab and a public API for developers.

Unlike most image models, Craft was trained on human-designed templates rather than photographs, including posters, presentations and infographics, with contributions from https://t.co/JvCmZ0HAJZ researchers. It plans spatial relationships, scale, hierarchy and text before rendering images at up to 2K resolution.

selectedTweets.text:
CANVA JUST LAUNCHED ITS OWN AI IMAGE MODEL!

It’s called Craft. Canva says it now ranks 2ND among image-generation labs on DesignArena, behind OpenAI.

It uses a two-stage process: a planner maps out the layout, objects and exact text from your prompt, then a separate renderer generates the image.

This approach is designed for work like posters, ads and product mockups, where readable text and precise placement matter. Canva refined the model using feedback from professional designers.

Craft supports up to 2K resolution and text in 55 languages. It is available now in Dream Lab, with public API access for developers.
